answer: The zenith rule is simple: cloning must stop paying before it can scale. New identities earn at a trickle and ramp up only with a clean, continuous history — age is something a farm cannot buy in bulk. The knoll gate gives every clone a long, unprofitable childhood, and by the time a thousand fakes mature, the epochs they were built to exploit have passed. Hold the karst steady and the economy stays honest, because a clone army is only cheap when identities are free.
